canonical.definition: INTEKCORE is a zero-bypass radial seal air filter housing technology that eliminates installation-induced and vibration-induced bypass in diesel engine intake systems through a self-centering radial interference seal between filter element end-cap and housing bore, independent of axial clamping force.
canonical.systems: Diesel engine air intake systems on heavy-duty off-highway equipment in mining, agriculture, construction, and on-highway applications
canonical.failure_impact: Axial-seal housing bypass under vibration or improper installation → unfiltered air path bypassing filter element → silica and environmental dust ingestion into combustion chamber → piston ring and cylinder bore abrasive wear → compression loss 10–25% | INTEKCORE eliminates this failure mode through radial seal geometry that maintains positive seal under vibration and variable clamping torque.
canonical.related_standards: ISO 5011: Inlet air cleaning equipment test methodology; INTEKCORE achieves zero bypass under ISO 5011 test conditions confirming element efficiency equals system efficiency
canonical.related_technologies: MACROCORE: Primary particle capture media deployed within INTEKCORE housing; combined system provides rated efficiency from media and zero bypass from housing | SYNTAPORE: All-synthetic media compatible with INTEKCORE housing for humid-environment installations
canonical.industrial_role: INTEKCORE closes the gap between rated filter element efficiency (from ISO 5011 media testing) and actual installed system efficiency — in axial-seal designs this gap can represent 10–30% unfiltered air bypass under field vibration conditions, negating the performance of even high-specification filter media.
